title: CreateEdge payload
description: Typed payload for the create-edge operation kind (registry code 2). Create a new edge (relationship) entity with an existence interval. The payload shape here is the canonical contract for this op kind; the implementation is built to it. Record-level access control (owner/acl/visibility) is intentionally omitted at M0: one principal with full authority, no record-level RBAC; policy is owned by Themis (M6) and arrives as explicit versioned policy operations (ADR-0030). Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile: all fields present, absent optionals as null, UUIDs lower-case hyphenated, HLC and valid times as decimal strings, layer as a kebab/lower value tag.

edge_id.description: Per-instance edge identifier, minted once at creation.

type_id.description: Metamodel relationship symbol UUID, e.g. realises.

exists_valid_from.description: Existence interval start, epoch microseconds UTC as a decimal string.

exists_valid_to.description: Existence interval end (half-open); null for open-ended.

hlc.description: Full-range HLC coordinate as a decimal string (canonical-JSON profile).

validTime.description: ValidTime as epoch microseconds UTC, encoded as a decimal string.

layer.description: Layer value tag as a stable schema-owned lower name.
